name: Pexafy Stock Photos
tagline: Search millions of free-to-use stock photos by description or by image, with licence and credit for each result
description: Semantic stock photo search over Pexafy's own index of millions of free-to-use photographs from Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay and other libraries. Search by description in any language or by visual similarity to a reference image, then retrieve any result as an image file. Every photo comes with its photographer, source, licence and a ready-to-use credit line. Read-only, with no API key required to get started.
